# TD9001: Clarification of FIA_UAU.2.1 for example devices

NIAP Technical Decision, Published, published 2026-03-01.

Applies to: FIA_UAU.2.1, PP_EX_V1.0-SD

## Protection Profiles

- Protection Profile for Example Devices Version 1.0

## Issue

The element does not say which users.

## Resolution

FIA_UAU.2.1 applies to administrators.

## Justification

Written for this repository's tests.
